text: This report recommends the 2020 meeting schedule for the Sign Variance Committee. The proposed schedule is guided by City Council’s approved schedule, and the availability of meeting space.
The Sign Variance Committee approved the following 2020 meeting dates: January 30, 2020 March 23, 2020 April 23, 2020 May 21, 2020 July 2, 2020 September 22, 2020 October 29, 2020 November 26, 2020
